derivedFrom.context: December is peak season. Activities sell out 3-6 months in advance.

actionItem.en: Book husky/reindeer rides and meet-and-greets months ahead. Expect long taxi queues.
actionItem.zh: 提前数月预订哈士奇/驯鹿雪橇和见面会。做好排队等出租车的准备。

names.zh: 欧纳斯瓦拉山 / 北极花园

derivedFrom.context: Rovaniemi creates light pollution. Move away from city center for better Aurora chances.

actionItem.en: Walk here from the city center for darker skies to spot Northern Lights.
actionItem.zh: 从市中心步行至此，寻找更暗的天空以观测北极光。

names.zh: 罗瓦涅米市中心 (洛迪广场)

derivedFrom.context: Sidewalks are packed ice. Pedestrians must use reflectors by law.

actionItem.en: Wear anti-slip grips on shoes. Hang a reflector on your coat visible to cars.
actionItem.zh: 鞋上穿防滑钉。在外套上悬挂对车辆可见的反光件。

derivedFrom.context: Strong alcohol >5.5% only sold in monopoly stores.

actionItem.en: Check opening hours. Closed on Sundays and holidays.
actionItem.zh: 检查营业时间。周日及节假日休息。
